fr.short: Quatre indicateurs clés mesurant performance devops (déploiement, délai, taux échec, récupération)
fr.full:
Les **DORA Metrics** sont 4 métriques clés de performance du delivery logiciel issues des recherches du DevOps Research and Assessment.

**Métriques** : Deployment Frequency, Lead Time for Changes (temps commit→prod), Change Failure Rate (% déploiements causant incidents), Time to Restore.

**Niveaux** : Elite (deploy multiple fois/jour, lead time <1h), High, Medium, Low.

**Usage** : mesurer maturité DevOps, identifier axes d'amélioration, benchmark équipes. Pas de "gaming" des métriques.

en.short: Four key indicators measuring DevOps performance (deployment, lead time, failure rate, recovery)
en.full:
The **DORA Metrics** are 4 key software delivery performance metrics from the DevOps Research and Assessment program.

**Metrics**: Deployment Frequency, Lead Time for Changes (commit→prod time), Change Failure Rate (% of deployments causing incidents), Time to Restore.

**Levels**: Elite (deploy multiple times/day, lead time <1h), High, Medium, Low.

**Usage**: measure DevOps maturity, identify areas for improvement, benchmark teams. No "gaming" of the metrics.
